description: An ice cream store makes chocolate and vanilla ice cream by the gallon. In a week, they must make at least 5 gallons of each type but at most 10 gallons of chocolate ice cream and at most 8 gallons of vanilla ice cream. It takes 1 hour to produce a gallon of chocolate ice cream and 2 hours to produce a gallon of vanilla ice cream. In a week, 30 hours are available to make ice cream. In addition at least 6 workers are needed with 1 working on the chocolate ice cream and 2 on the vanilla ice cream at any time. If the profit per gallon of chocolate ice cream is $200 and the profit per gallon of vanilla ice cream is $300, how many gallons of each should be made to maximize profit?

MinGallonsChocolate.definition: Minimum gallons of chocolate ice cream to produce per week

MinGallonsVanilla.definition: Minimum gallons of vanilla ice cream to produce per week

MaxGallonsChocolate.definition: Maximum gallons of chocolate ice cream to produce per week

MaxGallonsVanilla.definition: Maximum gallons of vanilla ice cream to produce per week

ProductionTimeChocolate.definition: Production time in hours to produce one gallon of chocolate ice cream

ProductionTimeVanilla.definition: Production time in hours to produce one gallon of vanilla ice cream

TotalProductionHours.definition: Total production hours available per week

WorkersNeededChocolate.definition: Number of workers required to operate production of chocolate ice cream

WorkersNeededVanilla.definition: Number of workers required to operate production of vanilla ice cream

MinTotalWorkers.definition: Minimum total number of workers required

ProfitChocolate.definition: Profit per gallon of chocolate ice cream

ProfitVanilla.definition: Profit per gallon of vanilla ice cream

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing chocolate and vanilla ice cream"

constraints.description: MinGallonsChocolate <= Gallons of chocolate ice cream produced per week <= MaxGallonsChocolate
MinGallonsVanilla <= Gallons of vanilla ice cream produced per week <= MaxGallonsVanilla
ProductionTimeChocolate * (gallons of chocolate) + ProductionTimeVanilla * (gallons of vanilla) must be less than or equal to TotalProductionHours
WorkersNeededChocolate * (gallons of chocolate) + WorkersNeededVanilla * (gallons of vanilla) must be at least MinTotalWorkers

GallonsChocolate.definition: Gallons of chocolate ice cream produced per week

GallonsVanilla.definition: Gallons of vanilla ice cream produced per week
